titleEnglish: Wishlōn Anām al-Layl — How Can I Sleep at Night?
note: A traditional Iraqi qasida in praise of the Prophet ﷺ. Repeat the refrain after each verse.

verses.ar: وِشْلُون أَنَام اللَّيل وِشْلُون أَنَامَه ۞ حَبِيبِي مُحَمَّد جَوْهَر كَلَامَه
verses.tr: Wishlōn anām il-layl, wishlōn anāmuh · Ḥabībī Muḥammad, jawhar kalāmuh
verses.en: How can I sleep at night — how could I ever sleep? My beloved is Muhammad, whose words are jewels.

verses.ar: سَفِّن بِاللهْ يَا سَفَّان دِير السَّفِينَة ۞ أَنْوَار أَبِي الْقَاسِم لَاحَت عَلَيْنَا
verses.tr: Saffin billāh yā saffān, dīr is-safīna · Anwār Abī l-Qāsim lāḥat ʿalaynā
verses.en: Set sail in God's name, O sailor — turn the ship! The lights of Abū l-Qāsim have dawned upon us.

verses.ar: يَا رَافِق الْعُرْبَان وَاشْرَب لَبَنْهِن ۞ كُل الصَّحَابَة نْجُوم، طٰهٰ قَمَرْهِن
verses.tr: Yā rāfiq il-ʿurbān w-ishrab labanhin · Kull iṣ-ṣaḥāba njūm, Ṭāhā qamarhin
verses.en: O you who travel with the Bedouin and drink their milk — all the Companions are stars, and Ṭāhā is their moon.

verses.ar: يَا طَيْر الطَّايِر فُوگ أَبْيَض يَا بُو جْنَاح ۞ سَلِّم عَلٰى أَبِي الزَّهْرَاء گُلَّه الْعُمُر رَاح
verses.tr: Yā ṭayr iṭ-ṭāyir fōg, abyaḍ yā bū jnāḥ · Sallim ʿalā Abī z-Zahrāʾ, gulluh il-ʿumur rāḥ
verses.en: O bird soaring above, white one with wings — greet the father of Zahrāʾ; tell him life has slipped away.

verses.ar: يَا طَيْر الطَّايِر فُوگ أَخْضَر يَا بُو رِيش ۞ سَلِّم عَلٰى طٰهٰ گُلَّه دَرَاوِيش
verses.tr: Yā ṭayr iṭ-ṭāyir fōg, akhḍar yā bū rīsh · Sallim ʿalā Ṭāhā, gulluh darāwīsh
verses.en: O bird soaring above, green one with feathers — greet Ṭāhā; tell him we've become dervishes, poor wanderers in love.

verses.ar: مَا أَرِيد أَمُوت الْيَوم، كَفْنِي عَبَاتِي ۞ دِزُّوا عَلٰى طٰهٰ يِحْضَر وَفَاتِي
verses.tr: Mā arīd amūt il-yōm, kafnī ʿabātī · Dizzū ʿalā Ṭāhā yiḥḍar wafātī
verses.en: I don't wish to die today — my cloak is my only shroud; send word to Ṭāhā, that he may attend my passing.
